description.mn: Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta: Хүйс харгалзахгүй цитрус үнэр (Cologne). Эхний ноот: гашуун жүрж; зүрхний ноот: иланг-иланг; суурь ноот: царсны хөвд, давирхай, заар, пачули.
description.en: Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta by Acqua di Parma is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta was launched in 2003. Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta was created by Bertrand Duchaufour and Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Bitter Orange, Bergamot, Lemon Verbena and Sweet Orange; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Vetiver, Jasmine, Cedar, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Paprika; base notes are Oakmoss, resins, White Musk and Patchouli.
